title: Ingest accurate daily person activity from API-enabled accounts

outcomes.statement: Group Admins have accurate, replayable person-day activity from API-enabled vendor accounts, using the same identity matching and idempotent persistence boundary available to CSV/manual ingestion.
outcomes.demo: Two people with different provider activity retain different counters; rerunning the same account/date updates the same rows and freshness; missing identities produce visible warnings; CSV/manual accounts cause no automatic provider calls.

uncertainties.statement: Official scope, policy and foundations are delivered.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-068 sync 1ac81e1 delivers canonical US-070, allocation from parent AC1/activity-side AC3/AC4, DEC-SMP-024 allowlisted replay payloads and DEC-SMP-025 manual default/explicit API opt-in. Parsed .nous-feedback.jsonl has done events for US-056, US-057, US-058 and US-046. The parent partition is docs/readiness/US-026.json; approval remains separately required. Four child ACs form two flows: (1) accurate identity-matched activity persistence including reruns/concurrency/warnings, and (2) ingestion-channel gating/shared writes. AC4 demonstrates AC1..AC3, not another independent feature. No approved parent design exists; US-070 requires its own Superpowers design before a bound plan.

uncertainties.statement: Correct connector activity grain and preserve identity warnings and replay evidence.
uncertainties.resolution: docs/readiness/US-026.json U2/U3 define the checked connector gap and approved allowlisted payload policy. Replace organization-total duplication with documented per-user counters, preserve null/unmatched identities as warning evidence and update contract-backed fixtures. Stop and reassess if current provider schema or beta policy requires additional scope.

uncertainties.statement: Introduce ingestion-mode gating, activity source/upserts and runtime privileges.
uncertainties.resolution: docs/readiness/US-026.json U4/U5 identify missing fields, uniqueness parity and UPDATE grants. Add append-only migration and Drizzle declarations for VendorAccount.ingestion_mode and ActivityRecord.source/unique key, shared source/identity inputs and activity upsert support under ledger_app. Backfill unconfigured accounts to manual. Use Person.company_id for isolation and preserve account boundaries. Prove real-DB rerun/concurrency/freshness and migration parity.

uncertainties.statement: Deliver scheduled execution and warning evidence without implementing later consumer screens.
uncertainties.resolution: docs/readiness/US-026.json U6 identifies existing daily scheduler and deferred handler. Wire the activity delivery into analyticsSync using existing credentials, rate limiting, sanitized observation sessions and injected dates; expose unmatched counts/details through existing job/audit surfaces. CSV/manual callers get the same source-aware persistence entrypoint; actual import/manual UI remains US-055. Confirm lag/replay policy during design; no new route is included.

uncertainties.statement: Company isolation and runtime observation/credential seams are known.
uncertainties.resolution: packages/db/src/schema.ts person.companyId is the actual tenant column; telemetry and VendorAccount have no direct company_id. Resolve email through company-scoped Person rows, distinguish shared-account vendor identity from company authorization and verify isolation using real database fixtures. apps/worker/src/jobs/membership-poll.ts shows KEK-backed credential loading and observation sessions with provisioningActionId:null for sync operations; connector-call-observation.ts explicitly supports that shape. Reuse these delivered seams without copying feature logic. Global scheduled work may iterate trusted database company/account scope; source-aware caller input must not grant a foreign-company write. A need for a new authorization or locking lifecycle beyond the natural-key upsert boundary triggers reassessment.

uncertainties.statement: Dates, warning retention, resource lifetime and measurement will be explicit within the approved boundary.
uncertainties.resolution: Budget deterministic UTC at-minus-three-completed-days activity observation, consistent with the committed approximate three-day lag; present exact policy in the child design for approval. Keep null/unmatched identities as allowlisted warning records in existing persisted job/audit evidence, including account/date/counts, with no new screen and no unrelated identity data. Reuse the existing daily scheduler/account keys and failure handling, release DB connections/observations in finally, and prove overlapping runs via real-DB natural-key upserts. Migration slug analytics_activity_ingestion is canonical; use a fresh timestamp and never modify committed migrations. Expected 18 files/5 mutation shards are estimates, re-evaluated at plan/task boundaries; per-task previews intersect only touched production sources. Record phase actuals, preview_rounds/minutes, cold attempts, review loops and cost provenance under CHG-064..067. Runtime tests, migration apply/verify/parity, adversarial AC review and one final cold campaign are included in the 270-minute estimate; do not inherit historical parent timing as child actuals.
